description: This file defines the CometAPIImageGenerationConfig class, which manages configuration and request/response handling for generating images via the Comet API within the litellm framework. It extends a base image generation configuration, supports parameter validation, URL construction, and response transformation for the API.

classes.name: CometAPIImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for interacting with the Comet API for image generation, providing methods to validate environment, construct URLs, map parameters, and transform responses.

methods.description: Maps non-default parameters to optional parameters, validating supported parameters and raising errors for unsupported ones if drop_params is False.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs and returns the complete URL for the API request, based on configuration and environment secrets.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates environment variables like API keys and sets necessary headers for API requests.

methods.name: dict transform_image_generation_request( self, model: str, prompt: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms function parameters into a request body compatible with the Comet API for image generation.

methods.description: Transforms the raw HTTP response from the Comet API into the litellm ImageResponse format, extracting image data.
